name: Stackup layer order vs naming
description: Cross-examines the physical layer order against what the layers call themselves: inner-layer ordinals must ascend top-to-bottom, the outer layers must name the top and bottom sides, and the numbering must have no gaps. A mirrored or transposed stack passes every geometric check while producing an electrically wrong board. Unrecognised naming conventions report not_applicable rather than guessing.
what_it_measures: Count of disagreements between the stackup's physical order and its own layer names (0 when they agree).
